title: Pulse-pressure–pulse-rate coupling does not establish incremental hemoglobin prediction across separate NHANES samples
abstract: We fitted a pulse-pressure by resting pulse-rate interaction beyond nonlinear conventional measures in NHANES2007–2008 adults (n4574) and froze it for NHANES2009–2010 (n5032). Baseline-minus-augmented MSE was -0.000894 (g/dL)²;1000 source-target participant-refit bootstrap95% interval -0.005525 to 0.001387. Additive spline comparison, source-defined trimming and pregnancy exclusion did not establish benefit. This does not demonstrate equivalence or reliable harm. Exploratory cross-sectional AI-authored analysis with author checks and clean rerun, not independent peer review, causal inference or clinical validation.
keywords: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey
